title: Wi-Fi Enabled Edge Intelligence Framework for Smart City Traffic Monitoring using Low-Power IoT Cameras
abstract: arXiv:2611.32517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time traffic monitoring in smart cities demands ultra-low latency processing to support time-critical decisions such as incident detection and congestion management. While cloud-based solutions offer robust computation, their inherent latency limits their applicability for such tasks. This work proposes a localized edge AI framework that connects low-power IoT camera sensors to a client, or applies offloading of inference to an NVIDIA Jetson Nano (GPU). Networking is achieved via Wi-Fi, enabling image classification without relying on wide-area infrastructure such as 5G, or wired networks. We evaluate two processing strategies: local inference on camera nodes and GPU-accelerated offloading to the Jetson Nano.We show that local processing is only feasible for lightweight models and low frame rates, whereas offloading enables near-realtime performance even for more complex models. translated_title: 基于Wi-Fi的边缘智能框架：使用低功耗物联网摄像头进行智慧城市交通监控
translated_abstract: 智慧城市中的实时交通监控需要超低延迟处理，以支持事件检测和拥堵管理等时间敏感型决策。虽然基于云的解决方案提供了强大的计算能力，但其固有的延迟限制了其在此类任务中的适用性。本工作提出了一个本地化边缘AI框架，将低功耗物联网摄像头传感器连接到客户端，或将推理任务卸载至NVIDIA Jetson Nano（GPU）。网络连接通过Wi-Fi实现，无需依赖5G或有线网络等广域基础设施即可进行图像分类。我们评估了两种处理策略：摄像头节点上的本地推理和GPU加速卸载至Jetson Nano。结果表明，本地处理仅适用于轻量级模型和低帧率场景，而卸载方案即使对于更复杂的模型也能实现近实时性能。这些结果证明了成本效益（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Wi-Fi的边缘智能框架，利用低功耗物联网摄像头在智慧城市交通监控中实现本地推理或卸载至Jetson Nano进行GPU加速，无需依赖5G或有线网络即可达到近实时性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Wi-Fi-enabled edge intelligence framework for smart city traffic monitoring using low-power IoT cameras, demonstrating that GPU-accelerated offloading to Jetson Nano achieves near-real-time performance without relying on 5G or wired network infrastructure.
